review:
Munchies is a stripped-back Nolimit City slot that shows a single symbol per spin: a multiplier or a blank. A bonus symbol starts ten It's Alive!! Spins, during which the reel count grows from one to two and then four reels linked together.

Landing more bonus symbols leads into Devour Spins, with +5 spins per symbol and the best multiplier carried forward. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 40,000x cap and a hit rate below 10%. A pure risk game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
